content.text: Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail

Traditional payment platforms often fail in regions like Cameroon due to compliance issues and geographical restrictions. COREMERCH offers a sovereign infrastructure that relies on blockchain technology and decentralized payment methods, allowing you to bypass these restrictions. You can accept payments in cryptocurrencies like USDT on Tron, which settles quickly and cheaply, and have complete ownership of your sales data without third-party interference. This infrastructure enables creators to serve both local and international markets efficiently.
What You Need Before You Deploy

Before you begin deployment, gather the essential tools and resources for your digital commerce stack. You will need a GitHub or Cloudflare account for hosting, a Google account for backend logic through Apps Script, and a NOWPayments account for processing crypto payments. Additionally, ensure you have digital products ready for sale, whether they are ebooks, courses, or other digital goods. Familiarize yourself with the infrastructure options available, such as the Sovereign Starter Stack or Edge Commerce Stack, which provide the necessary frameworks for deployment.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

To set up your payment and delivery pipeline, start by deploying your chosen stack using GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for hosting. Implement the backend logic with Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers to manage order processing. Integrate NOWPayments for seamless cryptocurrency transactions, ensuring you can accept payments in various currencies. For product delivery, utilize Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 to store and distribute your digital assets automatically. This setup guarantees that your customers receive their products instantly after payment confirmation.
Blockchain technology gives you complete control over your transactions.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

Once your infrastructure is set up, it's time to go live. Test your payment gateway by processing a small transaction to ensure everything functions correctly. Monitor the transaction flow from payment initiation to product delivery. Use the NOWPayments dashboard to track payment confirmations and verify that your customers receive their products promptly. Once the testing phase is successful, promote your digital products to your target audience, leveraging social media and other channels to drive traffic to your store.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

After successfully processing initial transactions, consider scaling your operations. Expand your digital product offerings by adding more items to your store, leveraging the Complete Builder Kit ($197) to access additional blueprints and templates for growth. Optimize your marketing strategies by targeting international buyers and utilizing Binance P2P for local currency support. Continuously monitor your infrastructure's performance and make improvements as necessary to ensure your digital commerce stack remains efficient and effective.
How can creators in Africa sell digital products to international buyers?

Global access through sovereign infrastructure works because every layer of the stack is geography-neutral by design. Cloudflare Pages serves your storefront from data centers close to your buyer — whether they are in London or Lagos, the page loads in under 200 milliseconds. NOWPayments generates a unique payment address for each transaction — the buyer sends crypto from any wallet, anywhere in the world. The blockchain confirms the transaction regardless of which country the sender is in. Your Cloudflare Worker receives the webhook and processes the order using the same logic for every buyer.
No reliance on traditional banking means faster payments for your customers.
Related: How Creators Like You Are Building Sovereign Stores

Global access to digital product revenue is not contingent on where you are located — it is contingent on which infrastructure you build on. The sovereign stack works identically from Lagos, Accra, Nairobi, Karachi, Dhaka, Harare, or Manila. The Edge Commerce Stack at $197 is deployed by COREMERCH in 48 hours under your accounts, tested on mainnet before handoff. The Sovereign Blueprint at $47 documents the complete build for self-deployers. Both are available at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Open a self-custody wallet — Trust Wallet or MetaMask — and back up the seed phrase before configuring anything else. Create your NOWPayments account and configure the self-custody wallet addresses as your payout destination. Open a Binance account and complete enough P2P setup to verify you can convert USDT to your local currency. Deploy your stack and configure the NOWPayments webhook endpoint. Build your product pages with USD prices and confirm the checkout generates QR codes and live price feeds correctly. Run a mainnet test transaction from a second wallet to confirm the full pipeline. Do a test P2P conversion with a small amount of USDT to confirm the conversion process works end-to-end. Promote your store.

You can accept payments in Cameroon using NOWPayments, which supports over 300 cryptocurrencies. This allows you to process transactions quickly and at low fees, enabling you to bypass traditional payment systems.

USDT on Tron is an excellent choice for transactions, settling in under 60 seconds for a fee under $0.10. This ensures quick and cost-effective payments for your digital products.
Can I sell digital products in Nigeria without PayPal?
Yes, by using NOWPayments and blockchain technology, you can sell digital products in Nigeria without needing PayPal. This allows you to reach customers effectively despite platform restrictions.
How can I promote my digital products internationally?
Promote your digital products internationally by utilizing social media platforms, engaging with online communities, and optimizing your website for search engines to attract a global audience.
What infrastructure do I need to start selling digital products?

To start selling digital products, you'll need hosting through GitHub or Cloudflare, backend logic with Google Apps Script or Workers, and NOWPayments for processing payments. Prepare your products and deploy your stack for a complete setup.
